$comment: Section 12 conformance matrix of the Originals Protocol, one entry per row. Each row is covered by a test that references its id, or stays status=todo. status=partial means some layers are tested and the note says what remains; coveredBy lists the citing test files (checked by packages/vh/tests/conformance/registry.test.ts). Phases follow spec section 10 and plans/011. status=not-applicable means an owner decision makes the row moot pending a spec edit; its note names the decision.

rows.test: Fresh create, edit, package and verify
rows.requiredResult: Same asset checkpoint and resource versions; no private key in reader

rows.test: Byte changed at same URL
rows.requiredResult: Digest failure; no verified resource result

rows.test: Wrong genesis or Original ID
rows.requiredResult: Identifier binding failure
rows.note: Asset state id, did:vh resolution of another SCID, and VH-Log genesis binding.

rows.test: Broken chain or reordered entry
rows.requiredResult: History invalid; no derived accepted state beyond failure

rows.test: Valid key of an identity other than the Original’s author DID
rows.requiredResult: Rejected; identity alone grants no edit right

rows.test: Valid VH entry, key not a method of the named author DID
rows.requiredResult: Author binding failure; VH validity cannot rescue it

rows.test: Wrong DID method binding or relationship
rows.requiredResult: Identity authorization failure

rows.test: Old identity version with claimed old time
rows.requiredResult: Unanchored: ordering unproven; no timestamp-only acceptance. Anchored: checked against the author DID state at the inscription time (P9.15)
rows.note: Unanchored case: historically authorized at the named version, ordering claimed, never current (P7.9). The anchored case arrives in PR 9.

rows.test: Missing identity history
rows.requiredResult: Incomplete identity evidence; no blanket verified result

rows.test: Missing historical resource bytes
rows.requiredResult: Explicit partial availability; supplied bytes still checked

rows.test: Caller changes version counter
rows.requiredResult: Counter ignored or rejected; history-derived version retained

rows.test: Stale parent or prior digest
rows.requiredResult: Conflict; no silent rebase or commit

rows.test: Signer rejects or returns invalid proof
rows.requiredResult: No partial state commit

rows.test: Interrupted local commit
rows.requiredResult: Recover prior or fully committed checkpoint; no false success

rows.test: Identical accepted retry
rows.requiredResult: Existing result or explicit duplicate; no unintended extra version

rows.test: Resource added, removed or renamed
rows.requiredResult: Rejected in baseline fixed-resource profile

rows.test: Metadata supplied, omitted or null
rows.requiredResult: Replacement, unchanged or removed, respectively

rows.test: Name set to null
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Update that leaves a resource’s digest unchanged
rows.requiredResult: That resource’s version does not advance

rows.test: Import then edit without authority
rows.requiredResult: Read succeeds where evidence valid; edit authorization fails

rows.test: Update after deactivation
rows.requiredResult: Rejected; historical evidence retained

rows.test: Old valid prefix served as current
rows.requiredResult: Freshness unresolved or failed under policy, never assumed

rows.test: Divergent valid branches
rows.requiredResult: Explicit fork/conflict, no timestamp winner
rows.note: Owner decision Q5: every branch is reported and none is current until anchoring settles it (P9.16).

rows.test: Author entry on one branch declares the other abandoned
rows.requiredResult: Declared branch and its descendants reported as abandoned, never current
rows.note: Owner decision Q5 (plan S1): fork declarations are dropped; C12-23 covers the replacement: a fork not on Bitcoin is an unresolved conflict with no current branch. Pending a spec edit.

rows.test: Each branch declares the other abandoned
rows.requiredResult: Unresolved conflict
rows.note: Owner decision Q5 (plan S1): fork declarations are dropped; C12-23 covers the replacement: a fork not on Bitcoin is an unresolved conflict with no current branch. Pending a spec edit.

rows.test: Hosted mixed snapshot
rows.requiredResult: Rejected before public result is marked verified

rows.test: Anchoring sat moved to a new holder
rows.requiredResult: Owner reported as the new holder; author unchanged

rows.test: After anchoring, author-signed entry not inscribed on the sat
rows.requiredResult: Not current

rows.test: Inscription on the anchoring sat not signed by the author, including by the owner
rows.requiredResult: Rejected; state unchanged

rows.test: Author-signed entry inscribed by the owner
rows.requiredResult: Accepted

rows.test: Entry that names a different sat or migrates after anchoring
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Newer inscription on the sat that does not extend the head
rows.requiredResult: Ignored; state follows the authenticated chain

rows.test: Same evidence inscribed on a different sat
rows.requiredResult: No ownership conferred

rows.test: Anchoring an Original from the local or web layer
rows.requiredResult: Accepted; ordering before the anchor claimed only; uniqueness not established; ownership provisional

rows.test: Entry after anchoring that adds a did:webvh alias when the anchoring entry’s state listed none
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Two valid anchoring entries for one Original on different sats
rows.requiredResult: The first in chain order is the anchor; the other and its descendants are a conflicting anchor, not current, conferring no ownership

rows.test: Later anchoring entry that declares an earlier anchored branch abandoned
rows.requiredResult: Declaration ignored; the first anchor stands
rows.note: Owner decision Q5 (plan S1): fork declarations are dropped, so this row is moot. Pending a spec edit.

rows.test: Anchoring entry inscribed on a sat other than the one it names
rows.requiredResult: Not an anchor

rows.test: Publication at the same or a lower block height than the previous accepted one
rows.requiredResult: Not accepted

rows.test: Bitcoin failure, retry or reorganization
rows.requiredResult: Durable boundary follows adapter policy, not pending intent

rows.test: Entry signed by a key removed from the author DID
rows.requiredResult: Unanchored: historically authorized, ordering unproven, never current. Anchored: rejected if its inscription time is at or after the removal’s versionTime
rows.note: Unanchored case: historically valid, never current (P7.9). The anchored case arrives in PR 9.

rows.test: Accepted anchored entry whose key the author DID later removes
rows.requiredResult: Remains current

rows.test: Author DID deactivated after an Original is anchored
rows.requiredResult: Accepted state remains current; entries inscribed later rejected

rows.test: Anchored entry naming an author DID version newer than its inscription time
rows.requiredResult: Checked against the named version

rows.test: Block whose timestamp is earlier than an ancestor’s
rows.requiredResult: Inscription time is the greatest ancestor timestamp

rows.test: Author DID history missing through an inscription time
rows.requiredResult: Incomplete identity evidence; not reported as current

rows.test: Author DID version published with a versionTime before an already accepted inscription it would reject
rows.requiredResult: Retroactive revocation conflict reported; result not silently changed

rows.test: Any entry after the author DID is deactivated
rows.requiredResult: Not anchored: Original reported as non-current. Anchored: accepted state remains current; entries inscribed later rejected (P9.15)
rows.note: Unanchored case: a deactivated author DID makes the Original non-current. The anchored case arrives in PR 9.

rows.test: Entry that sets updateKeys or nextKeyHashes
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Asset log entry that sets the witness parameter to anything other than an empty object
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Entry signed by a key the author DID added, with no asset log entry for the change
rows.requiredResult: Accepted

rows.test: Author key not in the author DID’s Originals declaration
rows.requiredResult: Author binding failure
rows.note: Tested as 'author key not under assertionMethod' (owner decision Q6, plan S8); pending the spec edit.

rows.test: Author DID versionId absent from signed state
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Verification method from another DID, with a different controller, or under authentication only
rows.requiredResult: Author binding failure

rows.test: Key expressed as JWK or a different multikey encoding
rows.requiredResult: Author binding failure

rows.test: Later entry names a different author DID, or an older author DID version than its predecessor
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Author DID using a method the profile does not list
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Anchored Original with a did:btco author DID, verified from Bitcoin alone
rows.requiredResult: Author binding checked against inscribed DID versions in chain order

rows.test: did:btco author DID version inscribed after an Originals inscription in the same block
rows.requiredResult: Not in effect for that inscription

rows.test: Anchoring entry naming the author DID’s own did:btco sat
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Inscription on a did:btco author DID’s sat after its deactivation
rows.requiredResult: Not a version; author DID remains deactivated

rows.test: Anchored Original whose did:vh or did:webvh author DID log is unavailable
rows.requiredResult: Incomplete identity evidence; not reported as current

rows.test: Two proofs in the proof array
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Stale author DID history served with a current asset log
rows.requiredResult: Identity freshness not established; not reported as currently authorized

rows.test: VH-valid log that fails Originals rules, read through a generic resolver
rows.requiredResult: Not reported as Originals-verified

rows.test: did:webvh whose document points to a did:vh that does not list it
rows.requiredResult: Not an alias; no Originals result through that did:webvh

rows.test: Asset state lists a did:webvh whose document points elsewhere
rows.requiredResult: Alias not confirmed; the did:vh still verifiable directly

rows.test: Served DID document for the did:vh that differs from the one derived from the log
rows.requiredResult: Ignored; the derived document is used

rows.test: Derived DID document
rows.requiredResult: Same for every resolver; `controller`, `alsoKnownAs` and `#files` match the author DID and asset state

rows.test: Plain did:vh resolver given an Originals log
rows.requiredResult: Rejected by its unrecognised `method` value

rows.test: Later entry that moves the log between plain did:vh and the Originals extension
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Proof using a cryptosuite other than `eddsa-jcs-2022` or `bip340-jcs-2025`
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Entry whose state is a delta rather than the full asset state
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Inscription carrying a compact delta
rows.requiredResult: Decoded to the full entry; hashes and proofs checked over the decoded entry

rows.test: Inscription that does not decode deterministically
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Lifecycle status deactivated without VH deactivated: true, or the reverse
rows.requiredResult: Rejected

rows.test: Older prefix imported over a newer local history
rows.requiredResult: Local current state not rolled back

rows.test: Log file larger than the profile cap
rows.requiredResult: Fetch refused; reported as unavailable

rows.test: Entry with duplicate JSON keys or an unsigned state field
rows.requiredResult: Parse failure; no verified state

rows.test: Resource digest with an unlisted algorithm
rows.requiredResult: Unsupported-profile failure

rows.test: Locator resolving or redirecting to a private address
rows.requiredResult: Fetch refused; reported as unavailable

rows.test: History or identity history beyond profile limits
rows.requiredResult: Last valid prefix reported, labelled limit-exceeded; never complete or current

rows.test: Archive with a symbolic link, `..` path or duplicate entry
rows.requiredResult: Rejected before extraction

rows.test: SVG resource containing script, or a name containing markup
rows.requiredResult: Not executed on the platform origin or in a client
